title: Steering deep CO2 reduction to C3+ hydrocarbons on nickel-based catalysts via ligand modification
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,2590-2597
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00029K, Paper
Ting Wang, Yuchen Wang, Fuping Pan, Kai-Jie Chen
A ligand-engineering strategy is proposed to modulate the electronic properties of nickel hydroxide catalyst via surface cysteamine modification. This strategy can boost C–C coupling in deep CO2 reduction to C3+ hydrocarbons.
